leadText:
A Collector (Japanese: ポケモンコレクター Pokémon Collector) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in the Generation III games. They are generally depicted as nerdy young men carrying many Poké Balls.

In Generations III, , and , they use version-exclusive Pokémon. In and in , they use three Pokémon of the same species, while in they use rare Pokémon such as or . They often talk about how they wish to catch rare Pokémon.

In Generation I, one of Bill's titles was the Collector.

In Generation VII, they keep their Pokémon in Premier Balls.

In Luring in a Lickilicky, a Collector appeared during the Pokétch presentation taking place in Jubilife City.
 

 
 
===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!===
In Find Munchlax!!, a Collector appeared as one of the three Trainers searching for . He claimed that all Collectors dream about Munchlax due to its extreme rarity, and tried to use Honey to lure it out. However, his Honey was instead eaten up by Hareta.
 

===Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!===
A Collector appeared in GDZ50.

==Trivia==
Despite Hoenn's Collectors always being depicted with six Poké Balls, many of them have less than six Pokémon in their actual party.
In Pokémon GO, "Collector" is the name of an achievement awarded for catching at least 30 Pokémon.
